conditions.policy_output: Each vehicle's native normalized actuator coordinates.
conditions.interpretation: Measures performance with direct access to the control coordinates natural to each propulsion topology.

conditions.policy_output: A common body-wrench command mapped through a versioned, frozen allocator for each vehicle.
conditions.interpretation: Controls the policy-facing action semantics while exposing allocation feasibility and topology-specific residuals.

rationale: Topology-native actions avoid imposing an allocator that may favor one propulsion layout, but expose different policy action semantics across vehicles.
Common body-wrench actions align policy semantics, but allocator limits and residuals are part of the condition and may affect vehicles differently.
Reporting both makes those two defensible perspectives visible without asserting that either one alone is universally fair.
allocator_freeze_requirement: Each common-body-wrench condition must record the allocator artifact path and content hash before training begins; allocator retuning after observing policy outcomes is prohibited.
scope_limit: This resolves comparison protocol, not equivalence of actuator authority, allocator feasibility, vehicle dynamics, or simulator fidelity.
